Fallback (2) therefore fired ONLY when no breadcrumb resolved — and that ordering breaks exactly where fallback (2) is supposed to earn its keep. On a campaign whose FIRST breadcrumb lands at round j+1 — every campaign straddling the 2026-08-26 mandate landing, i.e. the dominant near-term population by this plan's own 28/2,572 measurement — fallback (1) resolves at v_{j+1} to S_{j+1}, a per-round-tail reference, PREEMPTING fallback (2) with a strictly LATER timestamp (S_{j+1} > P_j).
